tasks.title: Fix inventory.ts reserve bug
tasks.brief: In /tmp/vcmp/w/t2/src/inventory.ts, fix the `reserve(sku, qty)` function. Its doc comment says: 'Takes qty units if that many are left; returns whether it did.' The current code uses `if (have <= qty) return false;` which incorrectly fails when have === qty (i.e. it can't take the last units). It should only fail when there isn't enough stock, i.e. when `have < qty`. Fix the condition so reserve('A1', 3) succeeds when exactly 3 are in stock (taking all of them), and a subsequent reserve('A1', 1) then correctly fails because none are left. Only edit src/inventory.ts. Do not touch any test file or any other source file.
